## History

Miss Rogerson is a middle-aged Sunday-school teacher who taught a class for twenty years. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends her class alone, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels out of place during the lesson.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rogerson.md)

Miss Rogerson serves as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's Sunday-school teacher. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends her class for the first time, she feels completely out of place during the lesson. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reports the details of her day and her experience in the class back to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI.
